description: This PHP class extends a view for displaying a module list menu in the SuiteCRM application. It customizes the display by retrieving recently viewed items for the current user, processing their summaries and associated images, and passing this data to a template for rendering.

classes.name: ActivitiesViewModulelistmenu
classes.description: A view class for rendering the module list menu with recently viewed items in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Retrieves recent activity history for the current user, processes the items to include summaries and images, and renders the module list menu template.
